instruction.thesis: The FUNDING_EXTREME_SHORT thesis for this AMZN long was triggered by -29.81% annualized funding at entry (crowded shorts). The funding has now flipped to +32.76% — a complete sign reversal from deeply negative to strongly positive. This is the most extreme form of thesis resolution: not only has the crowded-short condition resolved, but funding has overcorrected to the opposite extreme (longs now paying shorts). The perp has moved from 262.02 to 262.34 (+0.12%), a minimal gain. With funding now strongly positive and the original crowded-short thesis fully resolved, the position should be closed. The overcorrection to +32.76% funding also suggests the perp may face downward pressure as longs unwind.
